purpose: A P-channel VDMOS conducts with the mirrored square law, not refused and not run N-channel.

oracle.derivation: VDMOS drain current in saturation is the Shichman-Hodges square law without W/L (ngspice manual, VDMOS power MOSFET model): |Id| = KP/2 (Vgs - VTO)^2 (1 + LAMBDA |Vds|), LAMBDA = 0. P channel: Vgs = -5, VTO = -1, Vds = -5, |Vds| >= |Vgs - VTO| = 4, so |Id| = 0.5*16 = 8 A, flowing from source 0 into node d and through vd from d to 0: i(vd) = +8 A. The reverse-biased body diode and gmin add 5e-12 A, under atol. ngspice-44.2 gives 8.000000000005 A (the 5e-12 is gmin*5 V).
